title: No way to check script to be executed when creating an item
description: I still cannot mark a script to be executed when an item is done when creating an item in the TUI modal.  I didn't check the webui but I assume the same bug probably exists.
plan:
## Root Cause Analysis

The bug has two distinct root causes across different UI surfaces:

1. **WebUI (client_full2.html) - Missing field entirely**: The "Create New Idea" modal in the client_full2 template is missing the done_script select field. The modal only collects title, board, and description. The submit function also does not include done_script in the POST request body. This is a straightforward omission — the other two WebUI templates (index.html and client_full.html) both correctly include a done_script select dropdown in their creation modals.

2. **TUI - Potential rendering/visibility issue**: The TUI's NewFeatureModal does include a done_script Select widget and correctly wires it through the submit flow. However, the modal has a constrained max-height (28 lines) which may cause the done_script field to be clipped or scrolled out of view, especially on smaller terminals. The field exists in code but users may not be able to see or interact with it.

## Impact Assessment

- Users creating items from the client_full2 WebUI can never set a done_script at creation time — they must edit the item afterward to add one.
- TUI users may not realize the done_script field exists if it's clipped by the modal height constraint.
- The done_script can still be set post-creation via editing, so this is a usability issue rather than a data loss issue.
- No other functionality is at risk; the done_script execution path when items complete is unaffected.

## Fix Strategy

- **WebUI**: Add the done_script select dropdown to the client_full2.html creation modal, matching the pattern already used in index.html and client_full.html. Update the submit function to include the done_script value in the POST body.
- **TUI**: Increase the modal's max-height or convert to a scrollable container to ensure all fields (including done_script) are visible regardless of terminal size.

## Risks

- The WebUI fix is low-risk since two other templates already implement the same pattern correctly.
- The TUI height adjustment could affect layout on very small terminals, but making the modal scrollable mitigates this.
- Need to ensure the server API endpoint accepts the done_script field in the creation payload (it likely already does based on how the other templates work).

## Scope

- Fix should be limited to the creation modal UI in client_full2.html and the TUI modal height constraint.
- Should NOT touch the done_script execution logic, the edit modal, or other templates that already work correctly.
- Should NOT change the server API — only ensure the client sends the field that the API already supports.
test_spec:
# Test Specification: No Way to Check Script to Be Executed When Creating an Item

## 1. Behaviors That MUST Be Verified

### 1.1 WebUI client_full2.html - Done Script Field Present in Create Modal
- **Behavior**: The "Create New Idea" modal in client_full2.html must include a "Done Script (optional)" select dropdown, placed between the Description field and the action buttons.
- **Success Criteria**: When the modal is opened, a select element with id "new-idea-done-script" is visible with a default "(none)" option.
- **Expected Output**: The select dropdown renders with the same styling as the existing board select field.

### 1.2 WebUI client_full2.html - Scripts Are Fetched and Populated
- **Behavior**: When the "Create New Idea" modal is shown, the available scripts must be fetched from the /api/clients/{clientID}/scripts endpoint and populated as options in the done_script select dropdown.
- **Success Criteria**: After the modal opens, the select dropdown contains one option per available script (plus the default "(none)" option). Each option's value is the script name and its display text shows the script name.
- **Expected Output**: If the server returns scripts [{"name": "deploy"}, {"name": "notify"}], the dropdown contains options: (none), deploy, notify.

### 1.3 WebUI client_full2.html - Done Script Included in POST Body
- **Behavior**: When submitting a new idea from client_full2.html, the done_script value from the select dropdown must be included in the JSON POST body sent to /api/clients/{clientID}/ideas.
- **Success Criteria**: The POST request body includes a "done_script" field. If a script is selected, it contains the script name string. If "(none)" is selected, it contains an empty string.
- **Expected Output**: POST body is {"title": "...", "board": "...", "description": "...", "done_script": "deploy"} when a script is selected.

### 1.4 WebUI client_full2.html - Done Script Field Resets on Modal Reopen
- **Behavior**: When the modal is closed and reopened, the done_script select dropdown must reset to the default "(none)" value.
- **Success Criteria**: After creating an idea with a done_script selected, closing and reopening the modal shows the select back at "(none)".
- **Expected Output**: The select element's value is an empty string after reopening.

### 1.5 TUI - Done Script Field Is Visible Without Scrolling
- **Behavior**: The TUI NewFeatureModal must display all fields, including the done_script Select widget, without them being clipped by the modal's max-height constraint.
- **Success Criteria**: The done_script field is visible and interactable in the modal on a standard terminal (80x24 or larger). The modal should either have a larger max-height or be scrollable so no fields are hidden.
- **Expected Output**: Users can see and interact with the done_script field without needing to know it exists off-screen.

### 1.6 Consistency Across Templates
- **Behavior**: All three WebUI templates (index.html, client_full.html, client_full2.html) must include the done_script field in their creation modals with equivalent behavior.
- **Success Criteria**: Creating an idea with the same title, board, description, and done_script from any of the three templates produces the same result on the server.
- **Expected Output**: The server creates an item with the done_script field set correctly regardless of which template was used.

## 2. Edge Cases

### 2.1 No Scripts Available
- **Behavior**: If the /api/clients/{clientID}/scripts endpoint returns an empty array, the done_script dropdown should only show the "(none)" option.
- **Expected Output**: Select contains exactly one option: "(none)".

### 2.2 Scripts API Returns Error
- **Behavior**: If the scripts fetch fails (network error, 500 response), the dropdown should gracefully remain with just the "(none)" option. The modal should still be fully functional for creating an idea without a done_script.
- **Expected Output**: Modal remains usable; idea can be created without a done_script.

### 2.3 Done Script Selected But "(none)" Intended
- **Behavior**: User selects a script, then changes their mind and selects "(none)" before submitting.
- **Expected Output**: POST body contains done_script as an empty string; item is created without a done_script.

### 2.4 Done Script with Special Characters in Name
- **Behavior**: If a script name contains special characters (spaces, quotes, HTML entities), it should be properly escaped in the dropdown and correctly sent in the POST body.
- **Expected Output**: The script name is preserved exactly as returned by the API.

### 2.5 TUI on Minimum Terminal Size
- **Behavior**: On a very small terminal (e.g., 80x20), the TUI modal should still allow access to the done_script field, either by scrolling or by fitting within the available space.
- **Expected Output**: The done_script field is reachable even on small terminals.

### 2.6 Creating Idea with Only Required Fields
- **Behavior**: Creating an idea with just title and board (no description, no done_script) should still work correctly from client_full2.html.
- **Expected Output**: Item is created successfully with empty description and no done_script.

## 3. What Constitutes Failure

### 3.1 Critical Failures
- The done_script select dropdown is not present in the client_full2.html creation modal.
- The done_script value is not included in the POST body when submitting from client_full2.html.
- The done_script field is permanently hidden/clipped in the TUI modal with no way to access it.
- Selecting a done_script causes the creation request to fail or error.
- The done_script value is sent but not persisted on the created item.

### 3.2 Non-Critical Failures
- The done_script dropdown is present but not populated with available scripts (missing fetch call).
- The done_script field is not reset when the modal is reopened.
- The scripts fetch error causes the entire modal to become unusable.

### 3.3 Regression Failures
- The fix breaks the existing done_script functionality in index.html or client_full.html.
- The fix breaks the edit modal's done_script field.
- The fix breaks idea creation when no done_script is selected (the "(none)" case).
- The TUI height change causes other modal elements to overflow or become inaccessible.

## 4. Out of Scope

- **Done script execution logic**: Whether the done_script actually runs when an item completes is not being tested. Only the ability to set it at creation time.
- **Visual/CSS assertions**: Exact pixel positioning, colors, or styling of the done_script dropdown.
- **Performance**: Load time of the scripts API call or modal rendering speed.
- **Server API validation**: Whether the server correctly validates or rejects invalid done_script values — the server API is assumed to already handle this correctly.
- **Edit modal**: The done_script field in the edit modal already works and is not being modified.
- **Other templates' creation modals**: index.html and client_full.html already work correctly and should not be modified; they are reference implementations only.
- **Browser compatibility**: Testing across different browsers or browser versions.
- **Authentication/authorization**: Whether the API key is correctly passed is not part of this fix.
- **Concurrent creation**: Multiple users creating ideas simultaneously is not a concern for this UI fix.
